component.name: Purpose
component.summary: Scientific monograph & technical dispatch desktop editor

description.p: Purpose is a dedicated desktop editor for The Technical Dispatch & Notebook. Craft Markdown and MDX monographs, manage engineering notes, preview mathematical equations and technical plots, and publish directly through Git.

Purpose major overhaul: archival book paper light mode default, dark mode toggle, full MDX component synchronization (EngineeringNote, EquationBlock, Measurement), document outline drawer, and live metrics.
